finalText: Dedup is in. Repeats with the same key inside a 5-minute window now get dropped — the log shows it kicking in right away, like `evt-0288` (quota-warning) dropped 2 minutes after `evt-0287`. That layers on top of quiet hours and the pager rules from before. 99 notifications were dropped this way, and the run still finished clean with 0 route errors.
